privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.crashText: Off by default. When on, crashes and unexpected errors are sent to a crash-reporting service in the EU so they can be fixed. Reports contain the app version, device model and OS version, and the error. Before a report leaves the phone, the app removes your VIN, adapter name and address, and AI server address and key; a crash inside the phone's own system code is sent without that clean-up and could, rarely, include a Bluetooth adapter's address. Reports never contain trip data or location. You can turn this off any time.

reset.confirmBody: This deletes everything the app keeps on this phone: settings, garage, history, scans, trips, maintenance log, alert rules, coding backups, backup files, label packs, security-access plugins, login codes, AI keys and the copies of exported files the app keeps. Copies you already shared or saved elsewhere are kept.

dev.title: Developer & simulator
dev.sourceHelpWeb: Bluetooth LE ELM327 adapters connect to a real car through the browser (Chrome or Edge). The simulator emulates a real ECU so every screen works with no hardware; a banner stays visible while it is on. Switching disconnects the current session.
dev.sourceHelpAndroid: Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi ELM327 adapters connect to a real car, and so do classic Bluetooth (“3.0”) ones paired in Android’s Bluetooth settings. The simulator emulates a real ECU so every screen works with no hardware; a banner stays visible while it is on. Switching disconnects the current session.
dev.sourceHelp: Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi ELM327 adapters connect to a real car. The simulator emulates a real ECU so every screen works with no hardware; a banner stays visible while it is on. Switching disconnects the current session.
dev.sppHelp: Classic Bluetooth: pair the adapter in Android Settings → Bluetooth first (usually “OBDII”, PIN 1234 or 0000), then pick it on the Connect tab. The bus sniffer is not available over classic Bluetooth.
dev.simGarage: A garage car is simulated from its base profile, with the VIN and supported PIDs learned from it.
dev.previewBundleHelp: Opens Report a problem with the bundle built and its size shown, so a size regression is visible (the adapter log is capped at {{capacity}} lines).
dev.customInputA11y: Custom fault codes to inject, comma-separated
dev.injecting: Injecting: {{codes}}. Reconnect the simulator to apply.
dev.customHelp: Enter codes like P0135 (letter P, C, B or U plus four digits). Invalid codes are ignored.
dev.dropped: Link dropped. With auto-reconnect on it reconnects in 2 s; three drops in a minute pause it.
dev.armed: Armed: the next simulator connect gets no reply to ATZ. Connect to see the diagnostics.
dev.failNext: Fail next connect: no reply to ATZ
dev.simControlsHelp: Test the connection hardening without a car: a dropped link, and an adapter that never answers.
dev.testCrashSent: Sent. It should appear in the crash service within a minute, with the sample VIN, adapter address and server address removed.
dev.testCrashNotSent: Not sent: crash reporting is off or not available in this build.
dev.testCrashHelp: Sends one test report with a sample VIN and adapter address, to check they arrive removed.
dev.testCrashOff: Turn on Settings → Privacy → Send anonymous crash reports first (needs a build with a crash-reporting address).

seed.title: Security access plugins
seed.help: Some modules only accept a write after a security unlock: the module sends a number (the “seed”) and expects the matching answer (the “key”). The routine that turns one into the other belongs to the car maker. This app ships none and never downloads or works one out — you can install a routine you have for your own car as a small file.
seed.help2: A plugin is a list of simple arithmetic steps, checked and run in a sandbox: it only sees the seed and only produces a key. Without a plugin, writes to a locked module are refused before anything is sent. Plugins stay on this phone and are not part of a backup.
seed.importA11y: Import a security access plugin from a file
seed.warning: Install only a routine for your own car. A wrong key counts toward the module’s lockout.
seed.none: No plugins installed. Writes to modules that need security access are refused.
